reason: I would not buy this as a student because the software is free only if I bring my own hosting and paid search or AI credentials. That sounds like extra cost and setup before I know whether it will help me get interviews.
objection: I do not want to pay for an AI tool or end up paying for hosting and providers just to try it.
would_change_my_mind: A genuinely free hosted trial with clear limits and no payment details, so I can see whether the job tracking works for my placements.
